govt_response.title: MoRTH pace figures
govt_response.summary: The ministry's data show the pace rising from about 12 km/day in 2014-15 to a reported peak near 36.5 km/day in 2020-21 and about 28.6 km/day in 2021-22 (the latter figures via secondary reports).

analysis:
At Baghpat on 27 May 2018 Modi was reported to say that highway construction had risen from 12 km a day under the previous government to 27 km a day. These are national figures, not figures for the expressway being inaugurated.

MoRTH data reported by Business Today give 11.67 km/day before May 2014 and 26.9 km/day in FY2017-18, consistent with the statement.

The Wire notes that from 2018 the ministry began counting lane-km, so later and earlier per-day figures are not strictly comparable. A reported later peak was about 36.5 km/day in 2020-21.
notes: Quote is paraphrased from PTI/DH reports (DH page 403 on fetch; claim seen in search summaries). Wire article date (2023) and body not verified. No video found. MoRTH primary document not opened; figures are via Business Today citing MoRTH. Date 2018-05-27 is the EPE inauguration date; Baghpat rally same day per reports.
